about.heading: Posting Isn’t The Problem
about.body:
You didn't start posting to become a video editor. You started because you needed more clients. So you film on Sunday, edit for three nights, publish, and wait. A few likes come in. No enquiries. Meanwhile the work that actually pays you sat untouched all week.

The issue usually isn't your message. It's that the edit never leads anyone anywhere. Nothing in the first seconds to stop the person who could afford you. No structure that builds enough trust to make them curious. No clear reason to book.

That's the part we fix. Since 2021 we've cut over 1,200 videos for coaches, creators and brands, and every one is built around a single question: will this make someone want to work with you? You get your evenings back, and your content starts doing a job.

services.heading: What We Edit
services.intro: Whatever you publish, the goal is the same: reach the people who can actually hire you, and give them a reason to. You send the footage, we handle the rest.

items.title: Short Form Video Editing
items.text: Shorts, Reels and TikToks cut to stop the right person, not just any person. Captions, sound design and pacing that hold them long enough to go looking for you.

items.title: YouTube Video Editing
items.text: Long-form edits that build real trust. Tight intros, no dead air, and a structure that carries someone from curious to ready to book.

items.title: VSL & Ad Creative
items.text: Video sales letters and paid ads made to sell. A clear hook, a clean structure, and a close that actually asks for the sale.

items.title: Podcast Editing & Clips
items.text: Clean multi-cam episodes, plus the best moments pulled out as clips you can post all week. One recording turns into a month of content, with no extra time on camera.

steps.title: Send Your Footage
steps.text: Drop the raw files in Google Drive, Dropbox or WeTransfer. No special folders, no setup call.

steps.title: We Edit It
steps.text: Your editor cuts, grades, captions and scores the video. First draft usually lands within 48 hours.

steps.title: You Review It
steps.text: Want something changed? Say so. Revisions are unlimited until the edit is how you pictured it.

steps.title: You Publish
steps.text: Final files arrive named, organised and ready to upload. Then we start the next one.
